info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce CMS Managed Content API
info.description:
Retrieve and search published managed content versions for Experience Cloud sites. Provides endpoints for querying managed content delivery channels and searching content across workspaces. Part of the Salesforce Connect REST API.

Contact Support:
 Name: Salesforce Developer Support

Comma-separated list of topic names to filter by

request.description: Returns published managed content versions for the specified delivery channel. Supports filtering by content type, language, and content keys. Used for headless content delivery to Experience Cloud sites and external applications.
